notes.title: Patch #6. Long-Awaited Goodies!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, train lovers! (◕‿◕)[/b]

We've rolled into another stop and it’s time to unload some exciting new cargo! Sorry for the delay — our train hit a few bumps on the way… but don’t worry, the tracks are clear now. Thanks so much for your patience!

A huge milestone! While working on the new Act, we received a surprising but incredible piece of news — we've passed [b]25,000 copies[/b] sold! That’s absolutely wild for us, and something we never dared dream of. Thank you so much for your amazing support! It means the world to us. <3

Now let’s talk about what this patch brings on board:

[b]What’s New:[/b]
● Act 7: Live a Full Life — Try to “complete” a whole life! 50+ new illustrations, tons of new choices, nonlinear paths, and multiple endings await!
● New Achievements — Unlock them as you explore the new Act!
● Italian Localization — Ciao amici! The game is now available in Italian!
● Act 2 Additions — 15 new traits have been added to spice up your choices!
● Timer Toggle in Settings — You've asked for it, and here it is: you can now turn off the timer and discuss decisions with your friends at your own pace!

[b]Fixes:[/b]
● Fixed known bugs with character generation in Act 2.
● Visual bugs have been patched up.
● Music playback bugs resolved.
● Some sound effects fixed, others added!
● Improved game stability overall.


[u][b]New DLC Available![/b][/u]
We’ve also launched some fun little DLC packs for those who want to support us — or just enjoy collecting cool extras!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777730/ShooShoose__Wallpapers_Pack/][b]Choo-Choose – Wallpapers Pack[/b][/url] - A set of high-resolution wallpapers so your desktop can match your favorite in-game scenes!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777740/ChooShoose__Cosmetic_Chaos_DLC/][b]Choo-Choose – Cosmetic Chaos DLC[/b][/url] - A bundle of silly, meme-worthy, and stylish train skins to customize your ride.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55324/ChooChoose_Master_of_the_Rails/][b]Choo-Choose: Master of the Rails bundle[/b][/url] - Grab it all in one discounted pack — wallpapers, skins, and the base game!


[b]Follow Us![/b]
We’ve just launched our developer page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/luniskystudio][b]LuniskyStudio[/b][/url]
Hit “Follow” to stay up-to-date with all our upcoming games and updates! We’ll be announcing new projects very soon…

Thank you again for your incredible support — it keeps our wheels turning and our hearts warm.

🚂 [b] Choo-Choose Team[/b] 🚂

notes.title: Micro-Patch #4
notes.content:
Hey there, train lovers! (◕‿◕)

It’s been a while! We’ve been deep in development, and although we’d love to tell you all the juicy details, we’ll keep the surprise for now…

To break the silence while we work on a big update, here’s a small patch to keep your engines running!

[b]What’s new:[/b]
● Refactored core code to reduce potential bugs
● Cleaned up internal files, removed leftover junk
● Reuploaded music tracks with better quality and balanced volume
● Fixed sound and localization issues for some characters in Act 2
● Updated a few backgrounds

!!! [b]By popular demand, we’ve [u]disabled the blur effect during pause[/u] [/b]— now you can examine your fateful choices more clearly

[b]Thank you for your support! [/b]
Act 7 is in the works, and there’s plenty of exciting stuff ahead — stay tuned! 💙

With love,
The Choo-Choose Team 🚂

notes.title: Patch #5. Back on track and releasing Steam trading cards!
notes.content:
[b]Hello to all train enthusiasts! (◕‿◕)[/b]

We’re back after a short break and immediately got to work... And then, out of nowhere, Steam informed us that trading cards are now available to us! 🎉 Yes, they are being released right with this patch! Now your badges collection can feature a beautiful locomotive, a wagon, or even tracks and sleepers!

But that’s not all! For true railway art connoisseurs, we’ve prepared a unique conductor’s cap badge, which you can obtain by collecting a full set of foil trading cards. So, dear collectors, it’s time to expand your Steam inventory! 🚆✨

Besides that, we continue improving the game, making it even more accessible and user-friendly, so here’s what’s new in this update...

[b]What's New:[/b]
● New localizations added: [b]Polish and Turkish[/b] – Welcome, friends! Now you can lay tracks in your native language.
● All achievements have been fully translated into all supported languages – now everyone will understand why they unlocked "Coffee Addict" or "Anti-Darwinist"!
● Act 2 is even more diverse! We’ve added 15 new character traits, bringing the total to 145 unique traits! More unique situations, more unexpected consequences!

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
● More time for decisions in all acts – now you have extra time to think things through (or to panic).
● More variation in choice generation in Acts 5 and 6 – the paths will be even less predictable!
● Code optimization – the game now runs smoother, faster, and without unnecessary slowdowns.
● Fixed sound bugs – no more sudden volume spikes or unexpected noises in the worst possible moments.

We're actively working on Act 7, and [b]we deeply appreciate all your support[/b]! There's so much more to come – stay tuned! 💙

🚂 Choo-Choose Team 🚂

notes.title: Patch #4.5: Winter Wonders on the Rails!
notes.content:
Hello to all train enthusiasts! (◕‿◕)

While we were hard at work on Act 7, nature surprised us with an unexpected snowfall. Winter came suddenly, along with the realization that finishing the next act would take a bit longer than planned. But we didn’t want to leave you without some festive cheer, so we decided to add a touch of winter magic to the current version of the game!

[b]What’s New?[/b]
● Snowfall! Yes, snow is now decorating every corner of your game world. Enjoy this wintery delight!
● Christmas hats for your trains! Dress up your locomotive with Santa’s hat and imagine yourself chasing after his sleigh. (Hmm, we might just have an idea for a new act…)
● Winter-themed main menu. Start your journey with a festive mood right from the start!

[b]Fixes:[/b]
● Characters no longer attempt to trespass on other tracks.
● Fixed a sound bug that could cause the game to freeze randomly.
● Censorship now works correctly: hidden content stays hidden, and visible content stays visible.
● Improved transitions between screens for faster and smoother navigation.
● Updated some character traits to better fit all supported languages.
● The timer now displays time more accurately, like a proper railway chronometer.


[b]We’ve also released a small, completely optional DLC. By purchasing it, you’re supporting us and helping bring not only this game but also future projects to life.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3384850/ChooChoose__Supporter_Pack/

The DLC includes:
● A golden train skin – shining like a festive firework!
● Confetti instead of smoke – turn every ride into a celebration.

You are our gold – thank you for your support! <3

[b]Thanks for your ongoing support.[/b]
See you soon on the new tracks! ❄️

notes.title: Patch #4: Endless Fun on the Tracks!
notes.content:
Hello to all train enthusiasts! 🚂 (◕‿◕)

As the seasons shift and the sound of crunching leaves prepares to turn into the whispers of snowfall (depending on your hemisphere, of course), we’re here to lift your spirits! Feeling a little tired? A touch of seasonal gloom? Worry not – we’ve got just the thing! Introducing Act 6: your ticket to an endless train ride of joy, chaos, and mindless entertainment.

[b]What's new?[/b]
● [b]Act 6: Endless Mode[/b] – No limits, no second-guessing, and absolutely no regrets. Just keep those wheels rolling and run over everyone in sight for pure, unfiltered fun!
● [b]New train skins[/b] – Fresh, stylish designs to suit every train mood. (Yes, even that mood.)
● [b]10 new character quirks for Act 2[/b] – Because more personality = more unpredictability!

[b]Quality-of-life updates:[/b]
● All achievements are now translated into your languages! ❤️
● Made it easier to unlock the "I Love Anime!" achievement. Because who doesn’t love easier anime?
● Streamlined some endings in Act 5. Go ahead, dive deeper into the chaos of love and lust.
● Added a Censorship toggle – because some things are better left to the imagination.
● Adjusted path probabilities to add a bit more variety. Say goodbye to déjà vu tracks!

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
● Addressed performance hiccups. Your train rides should now be smoother than ever!
● Fixed pesky sound issues that were ruining the vibe.
● Timer functionality is back on track. Tick-tock, train-stop!
● Resolved path-crossing issues – no more tangled tracks.
● And as for the sneaky assassin… let’s just say they’ve been politely asked to stay off other people's trees.

So hop aboard and enjoy the ride! Don’t forget to restart Steam to ensure the update is live.

[b] Thank you for your endless support[/b] (pun intended), and may your virtual tracks always be straight and true!

notes.title: Micro-Patch Hotfix: Velocity X!
notes.content:
Hello, virtual conductors of the rails! 🚂 (◕‿◕)

Releasing a couple of acts in one patch isn’t an easy feat! Along the way, some switches got a bit off-track, paths crossed, and a few signals went haywire. But worry not, as our elite repair team of rabbits led by Captain Beaver has jumped into action! Here’s a quick rundown:

[list]
[*]Achievements are now ticking along like clockwork!
[*]Presidents are no longer night vampires (and no longer wreaking havoc!).
[*]Those charming characters are behaving themselves and aren’t climbing trees.
[*]No more screen freezes, so all trains are running smoothly.
[*]Male parts are once again displayed correctly and in place! 😌
[/list]

[b]Thanks for your support, and may your in-game tracks always be smooth![/b]

notes.title: Patch #3: New Paths Unlocked at the Station!
notes.content:
Hello to all fans of trains and unexpected turns! (◕‿◕)

Time flies like an express train, and though we have lots in the works, we’re bringing you the highlights in this update. Without further delay – here’s the latest patch! Choo-choo!

[b]What's New:[/b]

● [b]Act 4:[/b] Step onto the global stage! Now you’ll have a chance to pick not just a country’s president, but a world leader! Help your favorite make it to the end – preferably alive.
● [b]Act 5:[/b] From trains and thrills to matters of the heart! It’s time to choose love over chaos and discover your level of... charm.
● [b]Train Skins:[/b] Temporary new styles for your locomotive in Acts 4 and 5.
● [b]New Characters:[/b] Act 2 now has 10 more standout personalities!
● [b]New Outfits and Hairstyles:[/b] Bringing more style to Act 2!
● [b]Additional Achievements:[/b] New milestones to unlock, plus some classic achievements made easier.
● [b]Enhanced Sounds:[/b] Improved audio to heighten your immersion on screen.

[b]Minor Fixes:[/b]

● Corrected spots where characters cleverly tried to escape the rails!
● Some Act 2 personalities have been rewritten for extra fun.
● Minor bugs impacting performance have been patched.


[b]Coming Soon: [/b]Act 6! We’re nearly there, and believe us, it’s exactly what you’ve been waiting for after a long day... ;)

Remember to log out and back into Steam to receive the update!

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

notes.title: Patch #2: We're accelerating!
notes.content:
Hello to all the train enthusiasts! (◕‿◕)

First of all, we want to say: "[b]¡Gracias, México![/b]" Your incredible enthusiasm has truly impressed us, and we are immensely grateful! We also noticed how much easier it became for many of you to play in your native language, so we will continue translating the game into more languages!

The next patch will be all about new content, bringing exciting new acts and even more adventures. The wait is almost over, but in the meantime, here is our second major patch to keep you entertained!

[b]What's New:[/b]
● Added three new localizations: French, Korean, and Japanese! If you come across any errors — feel free to let us know, and we'll fix them!
● Some endings have been adjusted to make them easier to achieve. We understand that some randomness was a bit frustrating, so... here you go ^_^.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
● Fixed some strange repetition issues to make the game more enjoyable.
● Updated the interface to ensure all languages display correctly.
● Some objects wandered off to incorrect layers, but we've put them back in place.
● Added a bit of optimization to prevent sudden performance drops!

Don’t forget to log out and log back into Steam to get the update!

[b]Thank you for your support.[/b]

notes.title: Patch #1: Moving Forward, Choo-Choose!
notes.content:
Hello to all the train enthusiasts! (◕‿◕)

Hold on tight—the first major patch is just around the corner! Yes, it’s been patiently waiting around the corner, but now it's ready to jump out and embrace you!

We’ve been closely following your comments, reviews, and reactions on streams and videos. A huge thank you for your feedback! We know you’re craving more content, but our first priority was to make the game as stable and comfortable as possible.

Now that the major issues have been fixed, it’s time to move forward!

[b]What’s new:[/b]
● We’ve added 4 new localizations: German, Spanish, Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese! If you spot any translation errors, let us know, and we’ll fix them!
● New choices have been added to Act 1 — we’re sure they’ll leave you a bit puzzled, especially when your parents unexpectedly walk into the room!
● New characters have arrived in Act 2. There are about 30 of them for now, but they’ll definitely add some timely relevance and a few fresh memes.
● And of course, Act 3 wasn’t left out! There are 6 new objects that will undoubtedly influence the world around you!

[b]Small fixes:[/b]
● Increased time for making decisions in Act 1 — now you can stress a little less.
● Minor text errors have been fixed.
● Slight adjustments were made to choices in Acts 2 and 3 — now less repetition and more fun.
● Train skin bugs have been fixed.
● Endings hints are now more informative.
● New interactive objects have been added to the maps.

And that’s not all! We’re already hard at work on Act 4 and have plans for Act 5. When will they be released? It's too early to say, but you can be sure—there are more choices to make ahead... or maybe not. It’s up to you! 😉

Don’t forget to log out and log back into Steam to get the update!

[b]Thank you for your support.[/b]
